task: Measure the existing NN's dependence on reference sequence, repeat, neighboring modification scores and quality
initial_evaluation: Complete fold0 test split, 109747 observations; the corresponding checkpoint was selected by the original training validation loss
model_policy: Frozen weights, no training or threshold optimization; original inputs and outputs remain unchanged
reference_replacement: Whole overlapping-trimer sequence window or whole repeat mask exchanged between sites within retained-read-count bins; joint condition uses the same donor for both inputs
read_replacement: Stratified empirical donor replacement; joint eight-channel ML vectors sampled by observed base, relative position and retained-read-count bin. Not an unrestricted whole-bag permutation
quality_replacement: Replace positive observed inverse-quality values within the same strata; preserve zeros, absent bases and padded reads
neighbor_definition: Positions -9..-1 and +1..+9; center ML is retained in neighbor_ml
primary_measure: Baseline F1 minus perturbed F1 in percentage points; report macro-F1, m6A DRACH, m6A non-DRACH and all inosine
context_metrics: For each motif stratum retain all three true classes when calculating one-vs-rest m6A F1
repeat_sd: Variation across three donor randomizations for the same frozen model; not fold SD or a confidence interval
limitations: Results quantify dependence under these specified perturbations, not causal biochemical effects or intrinsic feature utility
Reference-branch perturbation leaves reference-related MATCH/mismatch information in the read branch
Read resampling preserves within-position ML channel relationships and applicability, but disrupts within-read and within-site score correlations
Correlated inputs and interactions make the four effects non-additive; do not normalize them to sum to 100 percent
Operational weak labels are not independent chemical ground truth
Testing a removed-input model after retraining is a different experiment and is not performed here
